description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives. 

 Labcorp is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst Developer for a dynamic team in Durham, NC. 

 Our passion lies in leveraging LabCorp Holding's data assets, to create value for the company and its stakeholders. The IT Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst is primarily responsible for the design and maintenance of business intelligence applications. These applications include both new development and ongoing support for various LabCorp Holdings business units, including our Corporate IT function. The IT Business Intelligence Analyst will support and implement solutions using best-in-breed business intelligence tooling, to harness various disparate data sources coupled with our high speed data platform.
  
 For our Corporate IT function reporting, this position supports the following:
  
 Collecting, analyzing and delivering metrics to drive IT efficiency and improve service on a global basis
 Analyzing data from IT tools to determine trends and identify potential training and process improvement opportunities
 Partnering with key stakeholders across the IT organization including the IT Service Desk, Service Engagement Managers, Business Relationship Managers, and Service Owners to analyze data that will drive recommendations for improvement
 
 Work Schedule: 
 This is a full-time, exempt (salaried) position assigned to a First Shift schedule, with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible. 

 Work Authorization: This position requires permanent authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship (including H-1B, OPT/CPT, EAD, or other temporary work authorization) is not available.
 
 Job Responsibilities: 
 Partner with key stakeholders to understand goals and key performance indicators (KPIs)
 Participate on cross-functional project teams and initiatives, to design and deploy business intelligence solutions
 Design and deploy dashboards, analytical reports and metrics tailored to track trends and justify future business initiatives
 Monitor and process weekly/monthly/quarterly reporting needs for various services and programs
 Identify, investigate, and make recommendations to resolve data anomalies and BI platform performance issues
 Provide insights by understanding business needs and comparing to trends in data
 Clarify data inconsistencies and offer technical assistance/expertise as necessary
 Assemble comprehensive metrics by mining data from multiple sources and evaluating those metrics against internal and industry benchmarks
 Partner with internal customers to gather business requirements & develop solutions (tools) that best satisfy those requirements
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related discipline
 2 or more years of experience in an analytical role, with demonstrated experience developing metrics, identifying trends, designing dashboards and reports using enterprise business intelligence tools
 1 or more years of hands on experience with developing BI content in Tableau, SAP Business Objects or Cognos BI
 1 or more years of experience in SQL development
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Current or prior Labcorp experience
 Master's Degree in Computer Science or related discipline
 1 or more years experience with the following: BI content development with very large underlying data sets, Java Script development, ServiceNow software, Splunk and Tableau Server deployments
 1 or more years xperience with translating analytical and technical information into a user-friendly format
 
 Additional Job Standards: 
 Strong problem solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail
 Effective verbal and written communication skills
 Excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to interact with individuals at all levels within the organization
 Understanding of using ETL (extract, transfer, load) and replication processes to centralize and standardize data coming from one or more source systems
 Proficiency in MS Office Suite of products, including competency in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

 
 Benefits:  Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan.   Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan.   Employees who are regularly scheduled to work a 7 on/7 off schedule are eligible to receive all the foregoing benefits except PTO or FTO. For more detailed information, please  click here . 


 Labcorp is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer: 
 Labcorp strives for inclusion and belonging in the workforce and does not tolerate harassment or discrimination of any kind. We make employment decisions based on the needs of our business and the qualifications and merit of the individual. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), family or parental status, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, personal appearance, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic. Additionally, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law. 

 We encourage all to apply 
 If you are an individual with a disability who needs assistance using our online tools to search and apply for jobs, or needs an accommodation, please visit our  accessibility site  or contact us at Candidate_Accommodations@labcorp.com . For more information about how we collect and store your personal data, please see our  Privacy Statement .
